opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music), UK-based, at different career stages
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career with grants of up to £5,000 for the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers; eligible activities include recording, touring and marketing.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists and bands writing their own music based in Liverpool City Region, and future industry professionals in that region
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands outside London, in Liverpool City Region, with financial support of up to £5k to help reach career tipping points.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists and bands writing their own music based in Tees Valley, and future industry professionals in that region
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands outside London, in Tees Valley, with financial support of up to £5k to help reach career tipping points.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators invited to international industry-facing events.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK, with potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas
opportunities.summary: Gives composers with a strong track record direct access to funding at pivotal stages in their career, supporting up to 15 composers per year.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres
opportunities.summary: Offers an opportunity for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production with grants of between £5,000-£10,000.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.summary: Offers grant funding and capacity building support for independent promoters in England, supporting booking, programming and promotion of gigs, concerts, club nights, showcases and tours, and capacity building.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers who write their own music
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career. A bumper deadline is planned for the second half of 2026.
